note: Invented by the author of the smoke test. No guest wrote these. expected_topics and expected_sentiment are the author's own reading, so that the output can be looked at quickly. They are not labels: nothing is scored on them, and no threshold or prompt may be tuned on them.

reviews.text: Lovely stay. The room was spotless, the bed was very comfortable and the breakfast had plenty of choice. The staff were friendly and helpful throughout. We would happily stay again.
Great location, five minutes from the station. The room was quiet, the shower was powerful and the air conditioning worked perfectly in the heat. Excellent value for money.
No problems at all. Check-in was quick, everything was clean and the staff answered every question straight away.
Perfect for a short city break. The bathroom was modern and spotless, and the reception team arranged a late checkout for us without any fuss.
The shower was freezing cold every morning and the water pressure was almost non-existent. I told reception twice and nobody ever came to fix it. Very disappointing for the price.
The room smelled of smoke and there was dust on every shelf. The sheets had stains on them. We asked for the room to be cleaned again and nothing happened.
The air conditioning was broken and the room was unbearably hot. We could not sleep, and the fan made a horrible noise all night.
We found a cockroach in the room on our second night. We reported it to reception and nobody ever came to deal with it.
The staff were lovely and breakfast was great, but the air conditioning in our room did not work and nobody came to fix it when we reported it.
Beautiful hotel in a great location. Sadly the bathroom was tiny, the toilet kept running and the shower drain was blocked.
Comfortable beds and a fantastic view. The room was not cleaned once during our four-night stay, and it took three phone calls before anyone brought fresh towels.
Friendly staff and a decent breakfast. The street outside was very noisy at night, which made it hard to sleep.
Nothing was wrong with the room, but I did not like the breakfast because there was no vegetarian choice and the coffee was cold.
